title: Technical implementation for african pharmacogenetic studies on CYP2D6 from archived breast cancer formalin fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissues
author: Nthontho, Tawe, et al.

steps.title: Section tissue for extraction
steps.instruction: Cut five tissue sections from the FFPE block, each 10 µm thick (instead of up to four sections ≤20 µm).

steps.title: Pre‑dewax tissue
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL xylene (or a commercial substitute such as Histo‑Clear) to the sections and incubate overnight to fully remove paraffin.

steps.title: Deparaffinize tissue
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Deparaffinization Solution, vortex vigorously for 10 seconds, briefly centrifuge to collect material at the tube bottom, incubate at 55 °C for 3 minutes, then allow to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Digest tissue
steps.instruction: Add 45 µL DNase/RNase‑free water, 45 µL 2X Digestion Buffer, and 10 µL Proteinase K to the sample, vortex, briefly centrifuge to pellet debris, and incubate overnight at 55 °C (instead of 1–4 h).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: After binding DNA to the purification column, add Elution Buffer, close the lid, incubate at room temperature (15–25 °C) for 30 minutes, then centrifuge at maximum speed for 10 minutes to collect the eluate.

description: The proposed protocol modifications to the DNA extraction method (pre-dewaxing, step2) resulted in higher DNA concentration and purity. We tested ten samples with the two methods, and we achieved an average of 852.63 ng/ul and 2250.94 ng/ul for standard and modified protocols, respectively; with a 1.58 and 1.88 OD260/280 ratio. The proposed protocols have been validated by Sanger sequencing of the PCR amplicons. See Supplementary materials. Specifically, we provide Sanger sequences for all the three genotypes (wild-type, heterozygous and double mutant, when available) by SNP. Sequencing work confirms the genotyping approaches proposed in this paper.
